name: Moulis-en-Médoc

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Malbec sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.
A ranking for Médoc châteaux left out of the 1855 classification. Any Médoc property may apply.

blurb.text: A Médoc appellation in Bordeaux for red wine, made from Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and other Bordeaux grapes. It covers Moulis-en-Médoc and parts of three neighboring communes: Castelnau-de-Médoc, Lamarque and Listrac-Médoc.
